descriptions.w3d_d24b_projectile_message_8009b670: Weapon projectile message handler: message 64 runs the base handler 0x8015fb34 then the start 0x8009c248 (failure gives 0x80004005), message 66 stops (0x8009c5e8); the fire message (cache 0x804ae018) when allowed (0x8009d7e4) and idle clears Worm.DisableMovementRef, posts the fire messages, sets the fire time +84 and state +44 and clears AI.BulletCount; the camera message updates +108; the finish message runs 0x8009c0cc, sets +112 and either ends through 0x8015fd1c or arms state 5 with the end time +124; other messages forward to the base handler.
